changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: pve-api-rule
changes.impact: The run writes one rule into the cluster firewall of Proxmox: ACCEPT from the platform's addresses (the seed and the node range) to the port of the Proxmox API. A rule with the same comment that differs is replaced by it. Nothing else in the firewall is touched, and no machine or pod restarts.
